description: Pre-sign check, before an agent signs anything on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663): send the transaction (to, data, value, and from), an EIP-712 signature request (typedData: Permit, Permit2, TransferWithAuthorization) or an x402 payment (x402: the PaymentRequired from the 402, or one accepts entry; agentId optional), and Toll answers ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK with the reasons, as an ERC-8265 RiskAssessment. It reads approvals (unlimited, to a plain wallet, to a contract we do not know, to a wallet the coin's own check names), transfers (to a burn address, the token itself, a router, a flagged wallet, an unknown contract), swaps (the router, who it pays out to, and the coin bought, through Toll's coin check: BLOCK only for findings whose coins rugged at 40% or more in our calibration), and x402 payments (payTo against the seller's registered ERC-8004 agentWallet, the seller's last delivery spot-check, the asset and amount). Calldata it cannot read is WARN, never ALLOW; a coin still being read is WARN with the seconds to wait. Robinhood Chain only. Facts, not advice.

agentId.description: The x402 seller's ERC-8004 agent id, when known

chainId.description: The chain id: 4663 (Robinhood Chain), the only one read; leave it out for 4663

data.description: The calldata, hex (0x for a plain send)

from.description: The signer's address (0x + 40 hex): a swap paying out to anyone else is flagged

to.description: The transaction's to: the contract or wallet it is sent to (0x + 40 hex)

typedData.description: An EIP-712 signature request: {domain, types, primaryType, message}

value.description: Wei sent with it, decimal or 0x hex (default 0)

x402.description: An x402 payment: the PaymentRequired the 402 sent (with accepts), or one accepts entry; optional payment (the signed payload) and resource (the URL)

name: check_tx
title: Check before signing
